<h2>Prepare Binary Prediction Metric Input</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates aligned binary observations and predicted probabilities and
computes counts shared by predictive metric evaluators.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_binary_prediction_metric_input(
  observed = NULL,
  predicted_probability = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="observed">observed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric vector containing only zero and one.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="predicted_probability">predicted_probability</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric vector of predicted probabilities in the closed interval '[0, 1]',
aligned one-to-one with 'observed'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing validated observation and probability vectors,
observation counts, prevalence, and 'class_status'. The status is '&quot;ok&quot;',
'&quot;undefined_no_presences&quot;', or '&quot;undefined_no_absences&quot;'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_binary_prediction_metric_input(
  observed = c(0, 1),
  predicted_probability = c(0.2, 0.8)
)
</code></pre>

</main>
